description:
Create a data center facility floor plan in Wondershare EdrawMax. 

Starting from a blank diagram, create a floor plan with the following specifications:
1. Room Dimensions: A rectangular room representing 30 ft x 20 ft.
2. Server Racks: Place 4 server racks arranged in a 2x2 grid in the center. Label them 'Rack A1', 'Rack A2', 'Rack B1', and 'Rack B2'.
3. Aisles: Leave space between the rows for a 'Hot Aisle' and spaces on the outside for 'Cold Aisle' (add text labels for these).
4. Cooling: Place 2 CRAC units (Computer Room Air Conditioning), one on the left wall and one on the right wall. Label them 'CRAC-1' and 'CRAC-2'.
5. Power: Place a PDU (Power Distribution Unit) near the bottom-left corner, labeled 'PDU-A'.
6. Safety: Place a Fire Panel near the entry door.
7. Access: Add an Entry Door on the bottom wall.
8. Infrastructure: Add a visual indicator (e.g., dashed area or shape) for a 'Raised Floor (24 in)'.
9. Title: Add a title block or text at the top/bottom reading 'Data Center Room 101'.

Save the editable project file as '/home/ga/Documents/datacenter_floorplan.eddx' and export the final image as '/home/ga/Documents/datacenter_floorplan.png'.
